commits.message: docs(just): deploy stages the URL handler binary, not the app; the README owns the no-cargo path
fix(just): deploy builds the URL handler before cargo, and the docs say macOS install needs it
fix(just): deploy builds the URL handler app on macOS, so install from a checkout finds it

feat(disk): files and their watch events go through one filesystem port, first used by the watcher registry and the binary watch (candybar-testing-ihvy.y10)

A Filesystem port (src/disk/) with one adapter over fs, an in-memory fake whose writes emit the events a watch would on the clock, and one contract both pass. The watcher registry, its delivery owner, plugin storage, folder identity, the link walk and the binary watch read the disk through it; IdentityRead and BundleStat are gone. A lint rule bans fs outside the adapter, with an allowlist of the files still to move.

fix(home): a home file named through a symlink is stored as the home's (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.lpl) (#634)

* fix(home): a home file named through a symlink is stored as the home's (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.lpl)

Whose a stored path is now follows the directories on its path, compared in
their on-disk spelling at the call, not its spelling: a client's cwd is a
realpath, so a --config under CC_CANDYBAR_HOME=/tmp/h arrived as
/private/tmp/h/... and was stored as the world's, and a copied home undid
into the original's config. The render checkpoint respells a requested home
file from the root as given, so what is stored reads back as itself. The
disk's spelling is a port on the stored root, and the watcher and the
spelling share one walk to the deepest existing directory.

* fix(home): a world record reached through a link reads back as the home's; one reading of the disk per operation (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.lpl)

Reading a record back had made the refusal of a world path depend on the disk,
so a record the released build wrote validly, or one a later link made
reachable from the root, dropped every session's undo history. The refusal is
lexical again; any other absolute path reads back in the home's spelling.

A StoredRoot reads each directory once per operation (oneReading): the render
checkpoint derives the request's spelling and its origin record from one
reading, and the history's load and save each take one, replacing the
per-caller memoizers.

* fix(home): a file named through a link into the home's tree is the home's (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.lpl)

An ancestor whose on-disk spelling lies inside the root places the file, not
only one that is the root, so a link from outside into a subdirectory of the
home no longer stores the home's file as the world's.

* docs(home): the stored-path reading and memory say only what holds (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.f00.lpl)
test(links): the composition golden's links carry their renderer's address (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.7q7)

fix(links): review — a template literal is read as a link's head, so a retired verb it ends on is still refused at load, and the compile holds its renderer's links where the draw reads them (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.7q7)

fix(links): review — a template's link verb is read by the click's own link parse, the URL handler's refusal never quotes the link, the doctor's and the verb table's words match the addressed grammar, and the protocol check reads each side once (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.7q7)

feat(links): a click reaches the renderer that drew it, by name: links are minted as cc-candybar://to/<name>/dispatch/…, the daemon's three click intakes share one link parse and one address check, and the URL handler dials the socket the name selects (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.b2l.7q7)

- The minter takes the renderer's address first, so no link can be minted
  without one. The name sits outside every signature: it only picks which
  process verifies.
- The renderer's link identity is one value, RendererLinks { to, signer },
  carried where the signer was: the compile, the render cache, the daemon's
  parts and the verbs' context.
- The parser returns `to` as a name or null. Old grammars and config-spelled
  links name none, and run where they arrive until b2l.eul and b2l.x87.
- url-handle relays the raw link. The click request carries `url` in place
  of verb and value. The version rule states why an in-bundle kind changes
  shape without a bump.
- One daemon helper refuses a link named for another renderer, on the url
  frame, the click request and the tmux range. Every click event records
  `to` (or `linkTo` for a range's link).
- Swift: address.swift holds the name rule and the socket file a link
  selects, checked before any path forms. main.swift logs the chosen file
  publicly. address-test.swift runs in CI's macOS job and `just
  test-url-handler`.
- check-protocol compares TS against every mirror a row names, not only
  the first. The Swift name rule, length, socket files, main's name and the
  address segment are pinned. The name vectors drop "main": they are the
  name rule's lists.
refactor(apply): a synchronous click needs no in-flight bracket on the idle clock; journaled refuses an async handler (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)
fix(apply): a probe link is refused by no client's leaving; the doctor stamps the hints it reads; the click error keeps its record's shape (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)
fix(apply): each click failure is its own held message; a fault's stack reaches the log; no gather starts after close (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

feat(apply): no turn awaits a launch; a doctor step is an effect, and a held click error accumulates (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.c3l)

A turn is a synchronous call: its body cannot be async (Synchronous<T>), a
render request never waits behind another session's probes, and no draw can
read a click half landed. A doctor step describes an effect; the performer
gathers after the click's turn through a recording view, and the landing
checks the gather's read set and config in the turn that writes the report.
Lands yth: a click error held while the last is live joins it.

fix(facts): a recording replays each frame from what its answer drew, in the file's order, with the recorded home (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.rat)

A live answer is drawn after its request's wait, from the view that request
holds. The recording now writes a draw line when the answer is drawn, after
the document and the declaration that draw read (each restated when it is
not the last the recording wrote), and only to the recordings that saw the
request arrive. The replay walks the file's lines in order: the recording
arm serves the last document reached and keeps no clock. The header carries
the home the payloads were composed against.
